sources.title: Choose a model: Palmyra X6, X5 and X4 comparison
sources.evidence: Current exact X4 column identifies model ID palmyra-x4, 128k context and text workflows, coding, data analysis and tools. X5 is separately described as adaptive reasoning and image-capable. X4 deprecation is scheduled December 14, 2026. No X4 count or network structure is given.

sources.title: Writer API changelog
sources.evidence: April 28, 2025 explicitly renames Palmyra X 004 to Palmyra X4; this establishes identity across the old and new names, not a new-model release date.

sources.title: Introducing actions with Palmyra X4
sources.evidence: October 9, 2024 formal release announcement says available in AI Studio and Ask Writer, demonstrates function tools, and states 128k context. Generic reasoning claims and the RAG tool thought process do not document a separate model thinking mode. Search-indexed full article was accessible; direct HTTP returned 403.

sources.title: Bringing AI superpowers to Slack
sources.evidence: September 16, 2024 dated article explicitly offers building apps with Palmyra X4 and deploying them through Slack. This predates the formal October announcement. The currently served article uses the later X4 name, so retrospective edits are possible; exact initial rollout day is not established.

sources.title: What is new at Writer: September and October 2024 entries
sources.evidence: September 17, 2024 Slack entry identifies Palmyra X 004 as an available model for general mode. October 9 separately announces the model and tool-calling update. Read directly from the served support page; it does not provide immutable historical revisions.

sources.title: Writer Palmyra X4 model specification and invocation schema
sources.evidence: Exact writer.palmyra-x4-v1:0 entry explicitly states 128,000 context and text modality. April 28, 2025 is the Bedrock availability date. Request schema documents ordinary sampling and response format; example reasoning_content is null, which alone does not prove a lack of reasoning support.

sources.title: Writer chat-completion API
sources.evidence: Current OpenAPI schema supports palmyra-x4 and function tool definitions. No X4-specific reasoning mode or reasoning-effort control is documented. Shared token-usage fields are not proof that this exact model supports an exposed thinking channel.

sources.title: Writer Platform Services Agreement, sections 2 and 5
sources.evidence: Developer terms grant limited non-exclusive, non-transferable platform access and restrict reproduction, modification and downloading components. Used with the documented commercial API distribution to support a descriptive proprietary classification. Indexed full terms were accessible.

sources.title: Palmyra X 004 dummy repository metadata
sources.evidence: The explicitly dummy repository ed07a15b022086795955124c6a03062cda602764 reports LlamaForCausalLM and 72,706,859,008 stored BF16 elements. Its files are manually gated. Dummy metadata is not a production-checkpoint count or sufficient proof of the deployed model architecture.

sources.title: Palmyra Creative model card
sources.evidence: The separately named Creative model states fine-tuning from Palmyra X 004 and its own 122B count. It does not state an exact production X4 count; derived-model specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Palmyra X 4.3 model card
sources.evidence: The separately named 4.3-73B model identifies X004 as its base and uses the Writer Open Model License. No assertion says the production X4 API has that count or license. Public rendered card was accessible; direct raw-file request returned 401.

sources.title: Writer-submitted 2025 transparency disclosure
sources.evidence: The later report identifies Palmyra X5 as its subject and discloses X5 count and MoE/hybrid architecture. It has no exact X4 technical column; those specifications are not inherited.

sources.title: Synthetic data: Busting the myths holding back enterprise AI progress
sources.evidence: January 2025 exact-X4 training discussion describes synthetic-data training and function calling but does not disclose total/active counts or network layout. Full indexed primary text was examined.

sources.title: Introducing self-evolving models
sources.evidence: November 2024 research describes experimental Transformer modifications and says they were not publicly available. It does not identify X4 as that architecture; no transfer is made.

sources.title: Writing in the Margins: Writer GTC presentation
sources.evidence: Complete presentation includes palmyra-x-004 inference examples and chunked-context processing. It does not disclose exact X4 parameter counts or network structure; inference pattern is not a model architecture specification.

sources.title: Palmyra X 004 launch interview
sources.evidence: Reporter attributes roughly 150B to Writer; no exact executive quotation establishes that figure.

sources.title: Exact named X004 repository
sources.evidence: The exact repository did not expose its card/configuration to unauthenticated access (401). No approval, credentials or weight downloads were attempted.

sources.title: NVIDIA Palmyra X 004 card route
sources.evidence: HTTP returned a generic application shell without an accessible exact model card; it supplied no production configuration or counts.

name.note: Current official name; formerly Palmyra X 004.

developer.note: Exact developer documentation and release announcement.

family.note: X4 is part of the documented Palmyra family.

release_date.note: Month precision is an inference from September 16–17 first-party availability statements, which predate the October 9 formal launch. Exact first public day is unresolved and the current pages may contain retrospective naming edits. April 2025 was a rename and later Bedrock distribution, not the initial release.

open_weights.note: Documented production access is commercial hosted service. Publicly listed dummy weights and separately named descendants do not establish an open production X4 checkpoint. Exact repository contents could not be inspected.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification supported by restricted service rights. The separately released X4.3 checkpoint license is not transferred.

parameters_b.note: No exact production total is established by examined primary material. Secondary reporting, dummy metadata and separately named descendants do not reconcile to a single verified X4 count. Later X5 disclosures are distinct.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact X4 active-parameter disclosure found in model docs, later comparison/disclosure material or examined training research; no total-to-active inference is made.

architecture.note: Dummy metadata suggests a Llama implementation but does not establish the production network. X5 MoE and experimental self-evolving Transformer research concern other models. Exact production architecture remains unverified after technical-source searches.

context_window.note: Native docs state 128k; AWS explicitly gives 128,000. Provider input/output limits are separate and are not summed to replace the advertised context.

modalities.note: Exact X4 serving specification is text-to-text. Family-level multimodal marketing and X5 image support are not assigned to X4.

reasoning.note: Clear baseline true: general reasoning ability, RAG thought-process explanations and a nullable shared response field do not establish a dedicated X4 thinking mode. No such exact-model API control or behavior was verified; this is not proof of inability.

tool_call.note: Exact launch code and API schema document function definitions and tool-call outputs.

description.value: Enterprise language model for workflow automation, coding, data analysis, and tool use
description.note: Baseline description matches documented use cases without benchmark superiority claims.

patch.notes: Palmyra X 004 was renamed Palmyra X4 in April 2025. September 2024 availability is inferred from dated Writer Slack announcements; October 9 is the formal launch, and the exact first day remains unresolved because current pages may contain later edits. Production total/active parameter counts and architecture are not established by the examined primary sources; dummy weights and related Creative, X4.3 and X5 specifications are not interchangeable. Generic reasoning claims do not verify a dedicated thinking mode. Writer schedules X4 deprecation for December 14, 2026.

summary: Audited all fourteen fields. Added proprietary service classification, replaced the October exact launch date with qualified September month precision from earlier developer availability statements, and cleared unsupported reasoning-mode assertion. Confirmed text modalities, tools and 128,000 context. Exact production parameter counts and architecture remain unresolved despite checking later disclosures, related cards, dummy metadata, training research and the developer GTC presentation.
